title_zh: 双堡对照 · 汤和与永昌堡
title_en: Two Forts · Tang He and Yongchang
subtitle_zh: 汤和布网，王德过桥，王叔杲筑堡，守灯人点灯。
subtitle_en: Tang He cast the net, Wang De crossed the bridge, Wang Shugao built the fort, and the lamp-watch lit the flame.
facts_zh: 《永昌堡》主书里“汤和”出现 0 次，“永昌堡”出现 639 次。
汤和漫画、短文、庙介绍里“永昌堡”出现 0 次。
唯一把“汤和”和“永昌堡”写进同一句的，是现代索引总结，不是原始史料。
facts_en: The main Yongchang Fort source mentions Tang He zero times and Yongchang 639 times.
The Tang He comic, essay, and temple introduction mention Yongchang zero times.
Only a modern index sentence puts Tang He and Yongchang in the same line; that is not primary evidence.

left.lead_zh: 汤和主持筑所城，留制度与海防网络。
left.lead_en: Tang He built the garrison and left behind an institutional coastal network.
points_zh: 洪武十九年，汤和筑宁村所；洪武二十年所城成。
“寓兵于民”把乡兵、屯田与海防接到一起。
宁村汤和庙原名“东瓯襄武王汤公庙”，与永昌堡东瓯王庙不是同一座庙。
points_en: In 1386 Tang He built Ningcun garrison; it was completed in 1387.
The 'soldiers among the people' system linked militia, farmland, and coastal defence.
Ningcun's Tang He temple was originally the Dong'ou Xiangwu Wang Tang Gong temple; it is not Yongchang's Dong'ou King temple.
left.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/汤和信俗(11.18)__抵御倭患第一人+汤和(1)(1).txt:3-7；docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/意绘抗倭英雄汤和-漫画全文.txt:706

bridge.body_zh: 嘉靖三十七年四月十九日，王德为解温州府城之围，移师宁村策应。四月二十日，他从宁村方向驰援，在金岙遭伏殉国。
bridge.body_en: On 19 April 1558 Wang De moved to Ningcun to relieve Wenzhou. On 20 April he rode out from Ningcun and was ambushed and killed at Jin'ao.
bridge.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:13760；:16301

right.lead_zh: 王沛、王德死后，王氏筑堡；王叔杲留下《沿海事宜》。
right.lead_en: After Wang Pei and Wang De died, the Wang clan built the fort; Wang Shugao left the 'Coastal Affairs' assessment.
points_zh: 嘉靖三十七年至三十八年，王氏筑永昌堡。
王叔杲《沿海事宜》评估宁村渡口、宁村马道与国初卫所部署。
1648 年宁村所被攻破，永昌堡独守八十余日，形成官堡/民堡对照。
points_en: The Wang clan built Yongchang Fort in 1558–1559.
Wang Shugao's 'Coastal Affairs' assessed Ningcun's ferry, horse road, and early-Ming garrison layout.
In 1648 Ningcun fell while Yongchang held out for over eighty days, a contrast between official and civic forts.
right.source_ref: docs/06-资料文本化/文档文本/永昌堡-十三进士与抗倭纪略-全文.txt:283；:15038；:312

timeline.zh: 王德移师宁村，次日殉国金岙
timeline.en: Wang De moves to Ningcun; dies at Jin'ao the next day

timeline.zh: 宁村破，永昌独守八十余日
timeline.en: Ningcun falls; Yongchang holds for over eighty days

timeline.zh: 汤和诞辰七百周年，五龙拼“天下太平”
timeline.en: Tang He's 700th anniversary; five dragon lanterns spell peace

do_not_claim_zh: 不要把永昌堡的东瓯王庙当作汤和庙；它祀汉东瓯王驺摇。也不要把汤和写成 1559 的活人主角。
do_not_claim_en: Do not treat Yongchang's Dong'ou King temple as a Tang He temple; it honours the Han-era Zoyao. Do not make Tang He a living protagonist in 1559.
